b: The company has filed for insolvency under self-administration. The Eppingen-headquartered Dieffenbacher Group is unaffected.
Dieffenbacher Maschinenfabrik, based in Zaisenhausen, Germany, supplies equipment for wood-based panel production and surface finishing (Image: Unsplash)

Dieffenbacher Maschinenfabrik, based in Zaisenhausen, Germany, has filed for insolvency proceedings under self-administration. The competent insolvency court has approved the application and appointed a court-appointed supervisor.
The proceedings are intended to facilitate the company’s restructuring and continued operation.
Despite the similarity in names, Dieffenbacher Maschinenfabrik is a legally independent entity and is not part of the Dieffenbacher Group, which is headquartered in Eppingen, Germany.
The Dieffenbacher Group and its companies are not affected by the insolvency proceedings.
